title: Tickets
purpose: Work the laboratory's tickets: open a view such as My open or Unassigned in my teams, search and filter, change several tickets at once, and save your own views.
summary: The laboratory's tickets, in views such as My open and Unassigned in my teams. Search, filter, open a ticket, change several at once, or log a new one.

tasks.title: Work your own tickets
steps: The list opens on My open: tickets assigned to you that are not resolved or closed.
Select a ticket's number to open it.
Use [[Views]] to switch to another list, such as Unassigned in my teams. Each view shows how many tickets it holds.

tasks.title: Log a new ticket
steps: Select [[New ticket]] and fill in the form. On a phone the button is in the bar at the bottom of the screen.

tasks.title: Find a ticket
steps: Type a number, subject, organization, contact, caller or reference in [[Search]] and select [[Apply]].
To look beyond your view, open [[Views]] and choose All tickets first.

tasks.title: Change several tickets at once
steps: Tick the tickets, or the header checkbox to tick the whole page.
Choose assign, set status or close in [[With the selected]] and fill in what it asks for.

tasks.title: Keep a list you use often
steps: Set the filters and sort you want, then select [[Save view]].
Name it and choose who sees it. It then appears under Saved views in [[Views]].

good_to_know: Filters narrow the view you are in. Under My open, Assigned to set to Nobody finds nothing. Choose All tickets for the widest list.
You only see tickets you may read. A ticket in a restricted category is listed only for its team's members and for supervisors.
A saved view keeps the view you chose, such as My open, with the filters, search text and order. Saved from a list where no view was chosen, it starts from All tickets.
Closing is all or nothing: one ticket that is not resolved, or a complaint not yet reviewed, stops the whole bulk close and nothing is closed.
The Overdue view and the Service clock filter depend on service targets. Where none is configured a ticket has no clock.

sections.title: Views and actions
paragraphs: Every active staff role can open this page. Client portal accounts cannot (access refused). Each view and its count are computed for you from the tickets you may read, so counts differ between people. A line under the title describes the current view.
Bulk actions apply to the tickets as you saw them: if one changed since you opened the list, the whole action is refused and names it. Reload and select again.

items.label: Views
items.description: Opens the list of views with the number of tickets each holds, then your saved views and the ones shared with you. The current view is highlighted. A view's count ignores the filters you have set on this page.

items.label: My open
items.description: The default view. Tickets assigned to you whose status is Open, Waiting on client or Waiting on third party.

items.label: Unassigned in my teams
items.description: Open or waiting tickets in a team you belong to that nobody is assigned to.

items.label: My teams
items.description: Every open or waiting ticket in the teams you belong to, assigned or not.

items.label: Waiting on client
items.description: Tickets whose status is Waiting on client: the client owes the next step.

items.label: Waiting on third party
items.description: Tickets whose status is Waiting on third party: an outsider owes the next step.

items.label: Overdue
items.description: Open or waiting tickets with a service clock past due. Service clocks exist when service targets are configured; a ticket with no clock is not overdue.

items.label: Complaints awaiting review
items.description: Complaints that have not been reviewed and are not closed, whether or not a decision is recorded and whether or not you may review them. The Complaints filter's Awaiting review is narrower: see below.

items.label: Resolved not closed
items.description: Tickets with status Resolved. Close them when nothing more is owed.

items.label: Recently closed
items.description: Tickets closed in the last 7 days.

items.label: All tickets
items.description: Every ticket you may read, whatever its status.

items.label: Saved views
items.description: Your own views and those a supervisor shared with everyone or with a team you belong to, each with who it is shared with. A saved view opens with its view (All tickets when none was chosen), filters and order. Its order does not change your own saved sort; a sort you choose while in it does. A shared view shows each reader only what that reader may read.

items.label: Rename, share or delete
items.description: A link under the heading, shown only on one of your own saved views. It opens the view's edit page.

items.label: Save view
items.description: Opens a form that stores this list's current filters, search text and the order it shows under a name, even the default order or one that came from your saved sort. Shown to every staff role; sharing needs the supervisor role.

items.label: New ticket
items.description: Opens the form to log a ticket. On a phone it is the main button in the bar at the bottom of the screen. Every staff role may log tickets.

items.label: Search
items.description: Matches the ticket number, subject, organization name, organization account code, contact name, the caller's name (Reported by) and the reference the caller gave, ignoring case. It does not search the text of entries.

items.label: Status
items.description: Any status, Open or waiting (the three statuses that are not resolved or closed), or one status. It narrows the current view, so a view and a status that exclude each other show nothing.

items.label: Assigned to
items.description: Anyone, Me, or Nobody (tickets without an assignee).

items.label: Team
items.description: More filters: tickets of one team.

items.label: Person
items.description: More filters: tickets assigned to one active staff account. Choose from the pick list; it searches as you type.

items.label: Category
items.description: More filters: one ticket category (not a category group).

items.label: Priority
items.description: More filters: Low, Normal, High or Urgent.

items.label: Organization
items.description: More filters: tickets of one client organization (any organization, active or not). Tickets logged without an organization are not matched.

items.label: Site
items.description: More filters: tickets for one client site.

items.label: Complaints
items.description: More filters: Any, Complaints, Not complaints, or Awaiting review. Awaiting review keeps the complaints that have a decision, that you did not record the decision for, that you are not assigned to and have never been assigned to, and that are not yet reviewed: the ones you may review as independent reviewer. Only supervisors review complaints, so for anyone else it shows none.

items.label: Service clock
items.description: More filters: Overdue, Due soon, Paused, On track, Met, Missed or No clock. Clocks are worked out from service targets, so this filter is meaningful once targets are configured.

items.label: Created from / Created to
items.description: More filters: the date the ticket was logged. The end date must not be before the start date.

items.label: Apply, Clear all and filter chips
items.description: Apply combines the search and filters and returns to page 1. Clear all returns to the current queue. In a saved view it restores the saved filters and sort. Removing a chip clears one criterion.

items.label: Filter and sort (phones)
items.description: On a phone the search, filters, Apply, Clear all, Columns and the sort choices are behind one Filter and sort button, so the first rows show straight away. The button shows how many filters are active. Tickets show as stacked rows instead of a wide table.

sections.title: Columns
paragraphs: The list is sorted by Updated, newest first, unless you sort another column. Sorting covers every matching ticket, not just the visible page. The Columns control shows, hides and reorders columns for your account; Number always stays.

items.label: Number
items.description: The ticket number, such as REQ-000123. It opens the ticket, which remembers this list and the order it shows, so Previous in list and Next in list can step through it and the ticket's Tickets breadcrumb returns here. Sortable.

items.label: Subject
items.description: The ticket's one-line subject, with its category below it. A Complaint chip follows the subject when the ticket is a complaint. Sortable by subject.

items.label: Status
items.description: Open, Waiting on client, Waiting on third party, Resolved or Closed. Sortable.

items.label: Service clock
items.description: The service clock's state in words (On track, Due soon, Overdue, Paused, Met, Missed, No target) with the earliest due time while it runs. Sortable by that due time.

items.label: Priority
items.description: Low, Normal, High or Urgent. Sorting orders by urgency, not alphabetically.

items.label: Organization
items.description: The client organization and, after a dot, its site. Shows No organization for an anonymous caller or an internal problem. Sortable.

items.label: Assigned to
items.description: The person assigned, or Nobody yet, with the team that owns the ticket below. Sortable by person.

items.label: Updated
items.description: When the ticket last changed, as date and time. Sortable.

sections.title: Change several tickets
paragraphs: The bar above the table acts on the ticked tickets. The header checkbox ticks only the rows on the current page, and the bar counts how many are selected. Every selected ticket must be one you may read, or the whole action is refused and nothing changes. Selecting nothing is refused. Success reads "N tickets changed."

On a phone, select a ticket or use Select this page, then tap Change selected tickets above the navigation bar. If a choice needs correcting, the sheet reopens. Your choices and the selected tickets still on this page at the same revision are kept. Review the count before applying again.

items.label: With the selected
items.description: Assign, Set status or Close.

items.label: Assign to
items.description: For Assign: choose a team, or a person from a team's list. Tickets already with that team and person are skipped, and closed tickets are refused. A person is offered only with the team they belong to. If the person is being deactivated or removed from the team at the same moment, the change saved second waits for the first: the assignment is refused, or their change returns the tickets to the queue. No reason is asked in bulk.

items.label: Status
items.description: For Set status: Open, Waiting on client or Waiting on third party. Resolved and closed tickets are refused (the message names them); resolve them or reopen them one at a time from their page.

items.label: Close
items.description: Closes the selected tickets. Each must be Resolved. A complaint also needs its independent review first. If any one is refused, none is closed and the message names the ticket.

items.label: Apply to selected
items.description: Runs the chosen action. Each changed ticket gets a timeline entry and an audit event. The list then opens again with the view, filters, search, page and any sort or rows per page you chose; your saved sort and page size apply as they stand then.

items.label: Columns
items.description: Show, hide or reorder columns. The preference is saved for your account and changes no data.

items.label: Rows per page and pagination
items.description: Choose how many rows to show per page. First, Previous, Next and Last keep the filters and sort; the footer gives the range and the total. Without a sort or rows per page chosen on the page, your saved ones apply, also after searching or filtering.

items.label: Empty states
items.description: No tickets here means the view is empty. No tickets match means the additional filters hide all its tickets. Clear filters returns to the same queue or restores the saved view. An invalid filter shows an error and no rows.
